title: The History of Sexuality, Volume 1: An Introduction

publication.edition: First American edition, trans. Robert Hurley (French original 1976)

verification.verification_notes: WorldCat and multiple scholarly reviews verified the volume and its 'Scientia Sexualis' argument that confession is a ritual discourse producing truth about the self.

copyright.notes: Monograph; analytical paraphrase only, no text reproduced.
